entities.name: SCG failure information procedure
entities.description: Procedure to inform NR MN about an SCG failure on E-UTRA SN the UE has experienced, such as SCG radio link failure or SCG change failure.

entities.name: MCG failure information procedure
entities.description: Procedure to inform the network about an MCG failure the UE has experienced, specifically MCG radio link failure. Allows UE to initiate fast MCG link recovery.

entities.name: RRC reconfiguration
entities.description: Message sent from network to UE for reconfiguring RRC connection parameters.

entities.name: SCGFailureInformationEUTRA
entities.description: Message sent from UE to network to report SCG failure on E-UTRA secondary node.

entities.name: MCGFailureInformation
entities.description: Message sent from UE to network to report MCG failure.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: AS security activated with SRB2 and DRB/MRB
entities.description: Condition where AS security is activated with SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB setup, or for IAB with SRB2.

entities.name: Fast MCG link recovery
entities.description: Property allowing UE to continue RRC connection without re-establishment after MCG failure.

relations.description: SCG failure information procedure includes sending SCGFailureInformationEUTRA message.
MCG failure information procedure includes sending MCGFailureInformation message.
MCG failure information procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
MCG failure information procedure requires AS security to be activated with SRB2 and DRB/MRB.
MCG failure information procedure enables fast MCG link recovery property.
